create_JunctionData_container: create a JunctionData container to store splice junctions with values and metadata for genomic tracks
filter_tracks_by_mask: filter JunctionData tracks by a boolean mask to select a subset of genomic tracks
filter_to_strand: filter JunctionData junctions to a specific DNA strand positive or negative
filter_by_tissue: filter JunctionData tracks by GTEx tissue type to isolate data for a specific tissue
get_junctions_to_plot: get a list of junctions to plot by filtering predictions by name strand and k threshold
